description: Section numbers and rule names that the claims table and the positioning caption cite (D-86, D-88). 'checked' is the paper revision the claims were judged against, used by BENCHMARKS.md; 'current' is the paper in docs/paper.pdf, used by paper/tables/. Update 'current' whenever docs/paper.pdf changes: dc-bench paper refuses a map whose current.sha256 is not docs/paper.pdf's. Each entry follows the claim's content, not its old section number. An entry with only 'current' is a section the paper cites where BENCHMARKS.md keeps an internal reference ({{iref:...}} in the template, or the positioning caption).
